# scatter3d { #mofography.visualize.scatter3d }

```python
visualize.scatter3d(
    X,
    name='trace name',
    mode='markers',
    marker_color='blue',
    marker_size=12,
    marker_line_color='white',
    marker_symbol='circle',
    marker_line_width=1,
    line_color='black',
    line_width=2,
    hovertext=None,
    text=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Return a Plotly Scatter3d for an N×3 array of points with configurable markers and lines.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type   | Description                                                                               | Default        |
|-------------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| X                 |        | the data matrix, with each row being a data point and each column being a feature         | _required_     |
| name              |        | name of the trace, defaults to trace name here (optional)                                 | `'trace name'` |
| mode              |        | 'markers', 'lines', 'lines+markers', 'text', 'none', defaults to markers (optional)       | `'markers'`    |
| marker_color      |        | color of the points, defaults to blue (optional)                                          | `'blue'`       |
| marker_size       |        | size of the marker, defaults to 12 (optional)                                             | `12`           |
| marker_line_color |        | The color of the line around the marker, defaults to white (optional)                     | `'white'`      |
| marker_symbol     |        | https://plotly.com/python/reference/#scatter-marker-symbol, defaults to circle (optional) | `'circle'`     |
| marker_line_width |        | The width of the lines around the markers, defaults to 1 (optional)                       | `1`            |
| line_color        |        | color of the line connecting the points, defaults to black (optional)                     | `'black'`      |
| line_width        |        | width of the line connecting the points, defaults to 2 (optional)                         | `2`            |
| hovertext         |        | text to show when hovering over a point                                                   | `None`         |
| text              |        | text to display when hovering over a point                                                | `None`         |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description               |
|--------|--------|---------------------------|
|        |        | A plotly scatter3d object |
